extracted.name: Cool Cucumber Salsa
extracted.description: This refreshing cucumber salsa with jalapeño, tomatoes, green bell pepper, cilantro, and a burst of lime is a great way to use summer cucumbers.
ingredient_lines: 2 medium cucumbers - peeled, seeded, and chopped
instruction_lines: Stir cucumbers, tomatoes, green pepper, jalapeño pepper, onion, garlic, lime juice, parsley, cilantro, dill, and salt together in a medium bowl; cover and refrigerate until chilled, about 30 minutes to 1 hour.
